verdict.rationale: Azure's own pricing pages document a free account option and a catalog of free Azure services, so a free starting path exists. The evidence is only page titles, though, with none of the limits, quotas, or expiry terms the story asks for, and no startup-credit program. Missing for 10: specific always-free service limits, free-account credit amount and expiry, a published startup credits program, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, starting is free — an always-free tier and/or published startup credits with the limits and expiry spelled out
